what: a block wholly inside the void of a hollow spherical-shell tool (r 18.5 to 40): cutting leaves it untouched, the tool never reaches it
method: the tool is the material between r=18.5 and r=40; the 8 mm block centred on the origin lies within r<=6.93 < 18.5, so it shares no volume with the tool: V = 8^3 = 512, still one body, centroid at the origin
